info.name: GenBioCa Evidence API (Milestone 5)
info.description:
Authoritative Milestone 5 Evidence lifecycle, typed links, and Evidence gate collection.

Purpose-specific Evidence IDs: approvedEvidenceId (file-backed approval/download/audit), draftEvidenceId (link/unlink + Checkpoint gate), rejectedEvidenceId, archivableEvidenceId, ineligibleKpiEvidenceId, kpiSuccessEvidenceId, policyCoverageEvidenceId.

Maker-checker: adminEmail creates/uploads/submits; reviewerEmail reviews.
Grant evidence:review (and policies:approve / kpi-actual:approve as needed) locally for reviewer.
KPI Actual IDs are manual prerequisites (requiresEvidence configs).
Do not use GenBioCa-GRC legacy /evidence/upload.

item.name: H. KPI Evidence gate (manual Actual IDs)
item.description:
MANUAL PREREQUISITES (not auto-created):
- kpiNoLinkActualId: PENDING_APPROVAL KPI Actual on a configuration with requiresEvidence=true and no Evidence links.
- kpiIneligibleActualId: separate PENDING_APPROVAL Actual (requiresEvidence=true) for DRAFT/ineligible link sample.
- kpiSuccessActualId: separate PENDING_APPROVAL Actual (requiresEvidence=true) for successful approval.
Prefer three distinct Actuals so failure scenarios do not poison the success path.
Reviewer needs kpi-actual:approve. Maker-checker still applies.
